Blast Gap Dive.name: Blast Gap Dive
Blast Gap Dive.description: When an explosion, a shock wave or a collapse fills the area, the user dives for the only gap in it: behind a pillar, at the edge of the blast, under a slab that holds. The user takes no harm from an area attack or falling structure they see coming, and can drag a person within arm's reach into the gap with them. Stamina: heavy.
